commands:
set -euo pipefail
BASE=1f79d3b74f28c1d3123a57fbd5e4f4a9b9a1fd78
BRANCH=work/photomap-straighten-20260912
git fetch origin "$BRANCH"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$BASE"
test "$(git rev-parse origin/$BRANCH)" = "$BASE"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
cd frontend
npm run build >/tmp/photomap-memory-baseline-build.log
BASE_GZIP=$(python3 -c 'import glob,gzip; p=glob.glob("dist/assets/public-map-*.js"); assert len(p)==1; print(len(gzip.compress(open(p[0],"rb").read(),mtime=0)))')
cd ..
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('frontend/src/components/map/PlaceMap.tsx')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";', 'import { lazy, Suspense, useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";', 1)
s=s.replace('import { MemorySheet } from "./MemorySheet";\n', '', 1)
anchor='const EMPTY_PLACE_GALLERY_ITEMS: PlaceMapVisualItem[] = [];'
s=s.replace(anchor, anchor + '\nconst MemorySheet = lazy(() => import("./MemorySheet").then(({ MemorySheet }) => ({ default: MemorySheet })));', 1)
old='''      <MemorySheet
        place={memoryPlace}
        onClose={() => setMemoryPlace(null)}
        onUploaded={() => {
          setMemoryPlace(null);
          setIsThanksOpen(true);
        }}
      />'''
new='''      {memoryPlace ? (
        <Suspense fallback={null}>
          <MemorySheet
            place={memoryPlace}
            onClose={() => setMemoryPlace(null)}
            onUploaded={() => {
              setMemoryPlace(null);
              setIsThanksOpen(true);
            }}
          />
        </Suspense>
      ) : null}'''
if old not in s:
    raise SystemExit('MemorySheet render anchor missing')
s=s.replace(old,new,1)
p.write_text(s)
PY
cd frontend
npm run lint
npm run build >/tmp/photomap-memory-lazy-build.log
AFTER_GZIP=$(python3 -c 'import glob,gzip; p=glob.glob("dist/assets/public-map-*.js"); assert len(p)==1; print(len(gzip.compress(open(p[0],"rb").read(),mtime=0)))')
MEMORY_CHUNKS=$(find dist/assets -maxdepth 1 -name 'MemorySheet-*.js' -print)
SAVED=$((BASE_GZIP-AFTER_GZIP))
echo "baseline_public_map_gzip=$BASE_GZIP"
echo "after_public_map_gzip=$AFTER_GZIP"
echo "saved_gzip=$SAVED"
echo "memory_chunks=$MEMORY_CHUNKS"
test -n "$MEMORY_CHUNKS"
test "$SAVED" -ge 2500
cd ..
VENV=$(mktemp -d /tmp/photomap-memory-lazy-e2e-XXXXXX)
python3 -m venv "$VENV"
"$VENV/bin/python" -m pip install -q -r backend/requirements.txt
cd frontend
PYTHON="$VENV/bin/python" npm run test:e2e -- e2e/smoke/public-map.spec.ts e2e/smoke/memories-reports.spec.ts --project=chromium --grep-invert 'visual:'
cd ..
rm -rf "$VENV"
./scripts/devctl.sh stop >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
git diff --check
git add frontend/src/components/map/PlaceMap.tsx
test "$(git diff --cached --name-only)" = 'frontend/src/components/map/PlaceMap.tsx'
git commit -m 'Lazy load map memory sheet'
git push origin HEAD:"$BRANCH"
printf 'published_sha=' && git rev-parse HEAD
